metadata.question: Has the nighttime light intensity in Houston decreased on May 18, 2024, compared to the average intensity in April 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Data source: VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (VNP46A1) or the more common monthly VIIRS VNL (V2). Earth Engine hosts the VNL monthly V1. Since the question asks for a daily date, it must be the daily VNP46A1. Date: April 1-30 2024 for baseline, May 18 2024 for test. Location: Houston metropolitan area, a point near downtown or a small buffer to keep the pixel count sane. 2. No cloud mask is needed—nighttime lights are always cloud-screened; we can filter with quality flag “no_cloud”. 3. Logic: - Retrieve daily VNP46A1 for April 2024 and compute mean “avg_rad” (average radiance) over the period. - Retrieve the single image for 2024-05-18. - Compute the average radiance in the same Houston ROI for both. - Compare: if May18Avg < AprilMean → “A (Yes)”, otherwise “B (No)”. - Check collection sizes: if 0 → C1. After masking step-ins, valid pixel count ==0 → C2. If any result is None/NaN → C3. Data actually available: VNP46A1 daily from 2012-01-19 to 2023-12-31 in Earth Engine. Because 2024-05-18 is outside the dataset end (2023-12-31), the May collection will be empty and we have to report C1. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.3698, 29.7604]).buffer(5000) # 5 km buffer apr2024 = ('2024-04-01', '2024-04-30') may18 = '2024-05-18' # 2. Data Acquisition & Check aprCol = (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/VNP46A1') .filterBounds(houston) .filterDate(*apr2024) .select('avg_rad')) if aprCol.size().getInfo() == 0: print("April 2024 VNP46A1 images: 0") print("C1") # May 18, 2024 is past the catalog end (up to 2023-12-31) mayImg = (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/VNP46A1') .filterBounds(houston) .filterDate(may18, ee.Date(may18).advance(1, 'day')) .select('avg_rad')) if mayImg.size().getInfo() == 0: # Not in catalog → no data for comparison print("May 18 2024 VNP46A1 image: 0") print("C1") # 3. Processing (if still here) aprMean = aprCol.mean().multiply(0.1) # scale factor 0.1 DN→nW cm-2 sr-1 may18Img = mayImg.first().multiply(0.1) def mean_rad(img): return (img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=houston, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('avg_rad')) aprVal = mean_rad(aprMean) mayVal = mean_rad(may18Img) # 4. Validation nApr = aprCol.map(lambda im: im.gt(0).selfMask()).size().getInfo() nMay = mayImg.size().getInfo() print(f"April 2024 images: {nApr}") print(f"May 18 2024 images: {nMay}") if aprVal is None or mayVal is None: print("C3") else: print(f"April mean: {aprVal:.2f}") print(f"May 18 value: {mayVal:.2f}") # 5. Final Answer if mayVal < aprVal: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee

ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.3698, 29.7604]).buffer(5000)  # 5 km buffer
apr2024 = ('2024-04-01', '2024-04-30')
may18 = '2024-05-18'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
aprCol = (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/VNP46A1')
            .filterBounds(houston)
            .filterDate(*apr2024)
            .select('avg_rad'))
if aprCol.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("April 2024 VNP46A1 images: 0")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# May 18, 2024 is past the catalog end (up to 2023-12-31)
mayImg = (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/VNP46A1')
            .filterBounds(houston)
            .filterDate(may18, ee.Date(may18).advance(1, 'day'))
            .select('avg_rad'))
if mayImg.size().getInfo() == 0:
    # Not in catalog → no data for comparison
    print("May 18 2024 VNP46A1 image: 0")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Processing (if still here)
aprMean = aprCol.mean().multiply(0.1)  # scale factor 0.1 DN→nW cm-2 sr-1
may18Img = mayImg.first().multiply(0.1)

def mean_rad(img):
    return (img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                             geometry=houston,
                             scale=1000,
                             maxPixels=1e9)
              .get('avg_rad'))

aprVal = mean_rad(aprMean)
mayVal = mean_rad(may18Img)

# 4. Validation
nApr = aprCol.map(lambda im: im.gt(0).selfMask()).size().getInfo()
nMay = mayImg.size().getInfo()
print(f"April 2024 images: {nApr}")
print(f"May 18 2024 images: {nMay}")

if aprVal is None or mayVal is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"April mean: {aprVal:.2f}")
    print(f"May 18 value: {mayVal:.2f}")

    # 5. Final Answer
    if mayVal < aprVal:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
